_policy: Real, dated, sourced or it doesn't go up. Each item illustrates a legal lesson — never celebrates violence. Balance mandatory: at least as many 'calm assertion worked' items as 'noncompliance went bad'. Prefer court records (durable) over videos (rot). Right-of-reply/takedown per site policy. Items verified by a human before adding; empty list renders an empty-state, never a broken page.
